description: Social and affordable housing: needs, costs and subsidy gaps by region is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by UNSW City Futures Research Centre. Estimates and analysis of unmet housing need across Australia, as developed by the UNSW City Futures Research Centre from 2021 Census data. This interactive resource identifies households in rental stress or facing homelessness across Australia. Data is available at national, state, Statistical Area Level 4 (SA4) and Local Government Area (LGA) level. Future unmet housing need is also projected out to 2041. Coverage is Australia, 2016 to 2041; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
